# Jacaranda Labs

> Six software ventures built by one operator and a set of agents, and the publications that study them. Harare, Zimbabwe.

## Sections

- [Laboratories](https://jacaranda-labs.pages.dev/): the six ventures and how they are built
- [Portfolio](https://jacaranda-labs.pages.dev/courage-garikai/): Courage Garikai, Autonomous Cognitive Infrastructure Engineer, Operator and Writer
- [Publications](https://jacaranda-labs.pages.dev/publications/): 20 works with availability stated
- [About](https://jacaranda-labs.pages.dev/about/): ownership and disclosure

## Ventures

- [AttestOS](https://attestos-edge.attestos.workers.dev/): Bot checks your visitors never see. An invisible proof-of-work check with a server-side verify call, in place of CAPTCHA puzzles.
- [TightBucket](https://0x.tightbucket.workers.dev/): Website leak audits. Twenty-second audits that show where a website loses revenue, with the evidence and the fix, for stores, SaaS, sales teams and agencies.
- [DeskOS](https://deskos.deskos.workers.dev/): Working desks for customs, safari and tender firms. Web desks with working calculators for customs and freight, safari and DMC, and tender and donor ESG firms, with daily open notices for tender firms from 13 public sources (World Bank, UN agencies, EU TED and national portals), by region.
- [STPi](https://getstpi.pages.dev/): Strategic Talent Placement Infrastructure. Hunts public job ads across African markets, drafts a cover letter and tailored CV for each, and waits for a person to approve before anything is sent.
- [Tapstall](https://tapstall.zlnew.workers.dev/): A shop link for the markets the big platforms skip. A storefront link for informal and social-commerce shops that understands EcoCash, InnBucks and PayShap and matches exact payment amounts.
- [Open Practice](https://open-practice.zlnew.workers.dev/): Practical AI, learned by doing. A learning platform where people practise with AI tools on real tasks, using their own free API keys, and keep what they make.

## Publications

### Books
- [Emotional Engineering for AI-Oriented Infrastructure Operators](https://jacaranda-labs.pages.dev/publications/emotional-engineering/): Trust, agency and ethical adoption in systems that act (private author-review, request a copy)
- [The Tight Bucket](https://jacaranda-labs.pages.dev/publications/tight-bucket/): Designing constraint-native digital businesses (private author-review, request a copy)
- [Proof of Mechanism](https://jacaranda-labs.pages.dev/publications/proof-of-mechanism/): How leaders who build with AI agents tell a working product from a convincing demo (private author-review, request a copy)
- [Nobody Was Watching](https://jacaranda-labs.pages.dev/publications/nobody-was-watching/): How founders run autonomous growth systems without harming strangers, their brand or themselves (private author-review, request a copy)
- [Flower and Bees](https://jacaranda-labs.pages.dev/publications/flower-and-bees/): The Jacaranda voice guide: how every page, product and message should feel (private author-review, request a copy)

### Working papers and reports
- [Constraint-Native Business Model Design](https://jacaranda-labs.pages.dev/publications/constraint-native-business-models/): Quota-bounded autonomy, proof-first acquisition and verification debt in a zero-cash, AI-built venture (private author-review, request a copy)
- [Simulated Completeness](https://jacaranda-labs.pages.dev/publications/simulated-completeness/): Claim–mechanism gaps, mechanism audits and the rebuild decision in an AI-era trust product (private author-review, request a copy)
- [Unwitnessed Autonomy](https://jacaranda-labs.pages.dev/publications/unwitnessed-autonomy/): Externalities, borrowed identities and duplicate clocks in an autonomous growth pipeline (private author-review, request a copy)
- [The Sovereign Micro-Enterprise](https://jacaranda-labs.pages.dev/publications/sovereign-micro-enterprise/): A Governance-First Architecture for Zero-Capital Agentic Businesses (published edition, free to read)

### Published editions

## Notes

- Contact: couragegarikai@atomicmail.io
